# Vendored Ckmeans.1d.dp C++ sources

These files are an unmodified subset of the C++ sources of the R package
[Ckmeans.1d.dp](https://cran.r-project.org/package=Ckmeans.1d.dp) by Mingzhou Song and
Haizhou Wang.

- Source: <https://github.com/cran/Ckmeans.1d.dp>, directory `src/`
- Package version: 4.3.6
- Commit: `c960a5334000b27ebc8badec661dac9784e430ba`

The files that depend on Rcpp (`RcppExports.cpp`, `Ckmeans.1d.dp_main.cpp`, `MCW_*`) are
not included.
